purpose: Deepen the bounded Grave Memory route into one readable risk-and-recovery circuit: understand the remains, recover from premature taking, accept only the settled memory trace, and carry its visible imprint back to the Core and Hub without reviving the archived multi-system route chain.
routeQuestion: Can the player learn from remains without becoming trapped inside them?

movementBounds.purpose: Keep the Core at its locked scale while giving the Grave route a real approach, sparse memory field, protected-remains journey, deeper consequence pocket, and return distance.

interaction.safeTransferRule: Pulse-read all four meanings, recover trace integrity and recoil with Stabilize, then hold Absorb only on the settled silt trace; consume no protected remains

consequence.state: read, stabilized, and below the authored recoil threshold
consequence.verb: hold Absorb gently near the silt after every protected meaning is understood
consequence.reaction: one memory thread enters the Core while the husk, scar, and inheritance seed remain embodied in the world
consequence.risk: premature or protected-remains Absorb disperses trace integrity and raises residue recoil
consequence.recovery: hold Stabilize near the read silt until integrity returns and recoil settles
consequence.meaning: the player carries an interpretation of the remains rather than carrying the remains themselves
consequence.coreImprint: asymmetric grave-memory pearl attached to the existing Binding Core body
consequence.hubImprint: the existing Grave comparison leaf retains the same pearl-dark memory response

visualConsequence.meaning: Failure scatters outward, recovery visibly reweaves the silt, safe transfer travels as one coherent thread, and retention becomes attached asymmetry on the Core rather than another orbit diagram.

returnFold.interaction: A / E after the route reading is complete

camera.feeling: broad sparse reverent spatial memory journey

playerFacingLanguage.read_old_core_husk: Approach the old Core husk and Pulse to read it.
playerFacingLanguage.pulse_memory_silt: Pulse the drifting memory silt before trying to hold it.
playerFacingLanguage.stabilize_memory_silt: Hold Stabilize near the read silt until its trace settles.
playerFacingLanguage.read_protective_scar: Pulse the scar plate. It protects the remains; it is not a door.
playerFacingLanguage.read_inheritance_seed: Pulse the inheritance seed without taking it.
playerFacingLanguage.recover_memory_trace: The trace scattered. Hold Stabilize near the silt until the recoil settles.
playerFacingLanguage.accept_memory_trace: Only the settled trace may enter. Hold Absorb gently near the memory silt.
playerFacingLanguage.memory_trace_entering: Keep the gentle draw steady. Carry the reading, not the remains.
playerFacingLanguage.memory_reading_settling: The trace is becoming part of the Core. Let it settle.
playerFacingLanguage.return_fold_ready: The memory pearl is retained. Return to the entry fold and press A.

spatialExpansion.rule: distance is added between existing meanings; no new verb, trigger class, objective owner, crossing owner, chemistry rule, or route branch
